settings.costing_hint: The labour rate and machine hourly rates are used for the actual costing of production orders.

machines.hourly_rate_hint: For actual costing: cost per hour of setup and production.

users.roles_hint: A user can have several roles (e.g. the owner: planning, sales and accounting) and sees the areas of all of them.
users.pick_role: Please pick at least one role

trace.title: Batch traceability
trace.intro: What was a batch made from, and which customers received it? For complaints and recalls: search by lot number, item, customer or delivery note.
trace.pick_lot: Pick a lot on the left

costing.title: Actual costing
costing.intro: Planned vs. actual cost per production order: material (actually consumed), machine and labour time (from shop-floor feedback) and the contribution margin. Hourly rates are set in the settings and on the machines.
costing.no_rates: No machine hourly rates set – machine cost is 0.
costing.empty: No production orders in this period
costing.estimated_hint: No times were reported for at least one operation. The planned time is used there (marked with *).

reports.title: Reports
reports.stock_hint: Current stock valued at moving average cost (else purchase or production cost).
reports.sales_hint: Revenue from issued invoices minus credit notes. Cost of goods = quantity × current unit cost; lines without an item (e.g. freight) have no cost of goods.
reports.negative_items_one: {{count}} item with negative stock – please check with a stock count.
reports.negative_items_other: {{count}} items with negative stock – please check with a stock count.
